name.zh: 二年级：专家系统与AI寒冬

description.zh: AI的第一批实用系统诞生了——专家系统试图将人类知识装进机器。然而，知识的获取远比想象中困难，过高的承诺最终引发了一场漫长的寒冬。在这里，你将见证希望与失落交织的年代。
description.en: AI's first practical systems were born — expert systems attempted to encode human knowledge into machines. Yet acquiring knowledge proved far harder than imagined, and overblown promises eventually triggered a long winter. Here, you will witness an era where hope and disillusionment intertwined.
